mapper.insert: insert into MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO_TOTAL select T1.* from MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T1 inner join fin_product T2 on T1.SEC_ID = T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID left join MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO t3 on t1.sec_id = t3.sec_id AND T3.VALUE_SOURCE=decode(t2.REGIST_ORG,#{SVR_REGIST_ORG_01},#{VALUATION_SOURCE_CBC},#{SVR_REGIST_ORG_02},#{VALUATION_SOURCE_SCH}) left join MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO t4 on t1.sec_id = t4.sec_id AND T4.VALUE_SOURCE=decode(t2.REGIST_ORG,#{SVR_REGIST_ORG_01},#{VALUATION_SOURCE_SCH},#{SVR_REGIST_ORG_02},#{VALUATION_SOURCE_CBC}) WHERE T1.VALUE_SOURCE = NVL(T3.VALUE_SOURCE,T4.VALUE_SOURCE) and T1.VALUE_DATE = #{date}
